title: Where Does Robustness Live? Neuron-Guided Adaptation for Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.02194v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Language Models (RALMs) have shown strong potential in knowledge-intensive tasks, yet they remain vulnerable when retrieved contexts are noisy or irrelevant. Robustness against such contexts requires two distinct capabilities: abstention when contexts are uninformative, and selective extraction when relevant evidence is buried in noise. Yet existing methods face two key limitations: they do not train separately for these two capabilities, and they adapt the model at a coarse layer- or module-level granularity, overlooking that only a small subset of neurons is strongly activated for a given input. translated_title: 鲁棒性存在于何处？面向检索增强语言模型的神经元引导适配方法
translated_abstract: 检索增强语言模型（RALMs）在知识密集型任务中展现出强大潜力，然而当检索到的上下文包含噪声或不相关内容时，它们仍然容易出错。针对此类上下文的鲁棒性需要两种不同的能力：当上下文无信息量时的弃答能力，以及当相关证据被埋没在噪声中时的选择性提取能力。然而，现有方法存在两个关键局限：它们没有针对这两种能力分别进行训练，并且在较粗的层级别或模块级别粒度上对模型进行适配，忽略了对于给定输入，只有一小部分神经元会被强烈激活这一事实。我们提出了NeuRIT，一个基于“定位优先”视角构建的神经元引导鲁棒指令微调框架。NeuRIT挖掘与相关和不相关上下文处理相关联的上下文感知神经元，并将它们作为锚点，选择性地适配已识别的神经元组及其所在的层。
tldr: 提出NeuRIT神经元引导指令微调框架，通过定位并选择性适配与上下文处理相关的特定神经元，分别训练弃答与选择性提取两种能力，从而提升检索增强语言模型对噪声和不相关检索上下文的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: NeuRIT is a neuron-guided instruction-tuning framework that improves the robustness of retrieval-augmented language models by localizing context-aware neurons and selectively adapting them to separately learn abstention and selective extraction capabilities against noisy retrieved contexts.
